trello.name: Configure Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Set up the Basic ($29/mo), Pro ($49/mo), and Enterprise ($99/mo) subscription tiers in the Stripe dashboard with their respective features and pricing.

trello.name: Implement Frontend Checkout Process
trello.desc: Implement Stripe Elements for the checkout form matching app design, include a clear feature comparison table for each tier, add prominent checkout buttons, and implement a tooltip explaining plan changes.

trello.name: Update Pricing Page
trello.desc: Update the application's pricing page to accurately reflect the new subscription tiers and their details.

trello.name: Build User Dashboard Subscription Features
trello.desc: Develop the user dashboard to display current plan details and billing info, allow users to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, provide access to invoices/payment history, enable payment method updates, and display real-time status notifications for changes or errors.

trello.name: Implement Backend Stripe API Integration
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to handle creating and managing subscriptions and processing payments for successful and failed transactions.

trello.name: Develop Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Set up and test webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded (activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify user/update info/email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (manage access rights/renewal options).

trello.name: Integrate Frontend with Backend API
trello.desc: Connect the frontend components with the backend API to ensure subscription changes are reflected in real-time on the dashboard and implement clear error notifications for users.

trello.name: Create and Execute Test Plan
trello.desc: Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up to billing to management), including specific scenarios for payment failures and cancellations.

trello.name: Develop User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Create a help section or FAQ covering common subscription issues and provide clear instructions for users on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues.

trello.name: Document Backend API and Webhooks
trello.desc: Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to facilitate future maintenance and troubleshooting.
